name: ia_code_section
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Iowa Code — Iowa state law — by citation. "714.2" is degrees of theft; "321J.2" is operating while intoxicated (OWI). Returns the statute text plus its amendment history (the Acts that enacted/amended it) and cross-references ("Referred to in ..."), each as a separate field. Pass "year" (2000, or 2004 through the current year) to get a historical edition instead of the current one. Keyless. Use for "what does Iowa Code 714.2 say", "Iowa OWI law", or to check an Iowa statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "714.2" or "321J.2". The chapter is the part before the dot and may carry letters, e.g. "714A.1" or "6B.1".

year.description: Optional. An Iowa Code edition year (2000, or 2004-2026) to retrieve a historical version instead of the current one. 2001-2003 were never published online by the Legislature. Omit for the current (2026) edition.

name: ia_code_titles
description: List the 16 titles of the Iowa Code with their official names and chapter-number ranges, e.g. Title XVI is Criminal Law and Procedure (chapters 687-916). Routing help for when you know the subject but not the chapter/section number — call this or ia_code_search before guessing a citation. Keyless.

name: ia_code_search
description: Search the Iowa Code by TOPIC or keyword rather than citation, e.g. "landlord security deposit", "concealed handgun permit", "operating while intoxicated". Matches against the Iowa Legislature's own official chapter and section CAPTIONS (not full statutory prose — Iowa does not publish a general-index or full-text search of Code section text, verified live) across all 16 titles, then returns the matching sections (or, if none match at the section level, the matching chapters) with their citations. Use ia_code_section afterward for the full text of a result. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".
